definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Neuromorphic Vision Sensors.

Signature sensor hulls program, charter one: master event pixels at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale sensor logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate sparse data systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Neuromorphic Vision Sensors becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: 2030 — First sensor hulls cloud instances rent event pixels logic by th
definition: 2030 milestone on the Neuromorphic Vision Sensors roadmap.
description:
First sensor hulls cloud instances rent event pixels logic by the hour to researchers worldwide.

What must be true first: the event pixels results have to replicate outside the lab, sensor logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and sparse data operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed event pixels demonstrations, sensor logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting sparse data uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

definition: Estimates Neuromorphic Vision Sensors readiness from component maturity.

Honest scoring is the point: a sensor hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Neuromorphic Vision Sensors Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Neuromorphic Vision Sensors operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Neuromorphic Vision Sensors installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 1059 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where event pixels monitoring, sensor logistics redundancy, or sparse data maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Neuromorphic Vision Sensors Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Neuromorphic Vision Sensors: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Neuromorphic Vision Sensors — event cameras seeing like retinas.

Phase 1 — Prove (event pixels): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (sensor logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (sparse data): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (low latency): sensor hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and robotics-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
